headline: Early observations and latest-benchmark reference only; not live opening quotes. Each figure carries its own effective date.
nigeria_note: CBN benchmark rates are those of 19 Oct (20 Oct not yet posted; the NFEM average reflects interbank deals only). Nigeria parallel ranges are withheld in this early edition: fewer than two reasonably current independent observations were verified at the cutoff.
markets_note: Latest official reference values with effective dates: Ghana mid of Bank of Ghana buy/sell (19 Oct); Kenya CBK commercial-banks’ average closing rates (market close 16 Oct, posted 19 Oct; not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB weighted-average bank rates (19 Oct, carried forward from the last verified HomePageRates read because SARB was unreachable at the cutoff); Egypt mid of CBE buy/sell (18 Oct, carried forward because CBE was unreachable at the cutoff).
nigeria_market_note_short: Parallel ranges withheld: insufficient independent observations at cutoff.
